catalog.summary: Analysis-Ready, Cloud Optimized (ARCO) is a data store of ERA5 re-analysis data currated by Google. This data is stored in Zarr format and contains 31 surface variables, pressure level variables defined on 37 pressure levels, and model level variables defined on the 137 native ERA5 vertical levels, all on a 0.25 degree lat lon grid. Temporal resolution is 1 hour.
